text: Start a capture anytime with {Ctrl+Shift+A}.
Copy the selected capture with {Enter}.
Press {Esc} once to deselect an annotation and again to cancel capture.
Drag anywhere to create a custom capture region.
Hover a window for auto-region detect and click to capture its full frame.
Move near a monitor top edge to select that full screen.
Touch the desktop's top edge to select every screen.
Click the top-center lock icon to save and reuse the same region next time.
Cycle ratios for social posts, slides, and portraits with the top-center ratio icon.
Use the mouse wheel to scale a preset-ratio region.
Hold {Shift} for 2% steps or {Ctrl} for precise 0.5% scaling.
Use the pixel magnifier to place an exact starting point.
Use {Tab} and {Shift+Tab} to move between annotation tools.
Use {Ctrl+Tab} and {Ctrl+Shift+Tab} to cycle the current tool swatch.
Double-click a swatch to make it the default.
Frame an area with Rectangle, then resize from any handle.
Use Oval to circle details, then drag its handles to resize.
Use Line to underline details, then reshape it from either endpoint.
Use Arrow to point at details, then reshape it from either endpoint.
Sketch freely with Pen, or switch its tip to an arrow.
Highlight with a line or area while keeping content readable.
Click for inline text or drag to create a wrapping text box.
Use {Shift+Enter} to add a line break inside editable text.
Use Tag for a callout box with a movable pointer.
Enable Numbering, then click to place sequential steps.
Double-click a numbered badge to replace its value.
Use Mosaic to conceal details while preserving nearby annotations.
Use the Watermark tool to add repeating text, dates, and/or a logo to your captures.
Undo the latest edit with {Ctrl+Z}.
Save the current capture quickly with {Ctrl+S}.
Tap {Enter} to take the current region and annotations directly to your clipboard.
Enable Auto-save in the tray to keep captures without prompts.
Open your auto-save folder from its tray shortcut.
Use Run on startup to keep Screen Cap'n ready in the tray.
Change the quick-access shortcut from the tray menu.
Reopen Screen Cap'n setup anytime from the tray.
Help us improve by reporting bugs to Support.
Improved versions will show the update badge. Click to update from the Store.
Drag and move the toolbar grip on the far left when it covers part of your capture.
Select an annotation to move it or resize it from its handles.
Right-click the canvas to leave the current edit cleanly.
Adjust line width with {Up Arrow} or {Down Arrow}.
